description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas, adding {C}{C}.
God-Eternal Rhonas dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the God-Eternal Rhonas trigger, putting it into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for God-Eternal Rhonas, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
God-Eternal Rhonas enters the battlefield, doubling the power of each other creature you control and giving them vigilance until end of turn.
Repeat.
